verses.english: Linked Discourses 35.101
10. The Sixes
It’s Not Yours (1st)
“Mendicants, give up what’s not yours.

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.
And what isn’t yours?
The eye isn’t yours: give it up.

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.
Sights …

verses.pali: Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.

verses.english: Eye consciousness …

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.

verses.english: Eye contact …

verses.pali: So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
Yampidaṁ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tampi na tumhākaṁ.
verses.english: The pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on eye contact isn’t yours: give it up.

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.
The ear … nose … tongue … body …

verses.pali: Sā vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
Yampidaṁ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tampi na tumhākaṁ.
Taṁ pajahatha. Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati …pe….

verses.english: The mind isn’t yours: give it up.

verses.pali: So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.
Ideas …

verses.pali: Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.

verses.english: Mind consciousness …

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.

verses.english: Mind contact …

verses.pali: So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
Yampidaṁ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tampi na tumhākaṁ.
verses.english: The pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on mind contact isn’t yours: give it up.

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yaṁ imasmiṁ jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṁ taṁ jano hareyya vā ḍaheyya vā yathāpaccayaṁ vā kareyya,
verses.english: Suppose a person was to carry off the grass, sticks, branches, and leaves in this Jeta’s Grove, or burn them, or do what they want with them.
Would you think:

verses.pali: ‘amhe jano harati vā ḍahati vā yathāpaccayaṁ vā karotī’”ti?
verses.english: ‘This person is carrying us off, burning us, or doing what they want with us’?”
“No, sir.
Why is that?

verses.pali: “Na hi no etaṁ, bhante, attā vā attaniyaṁ vā”ti.
verses.english: Because  to us that’s neither self nor belonging to self.”
“In the same way, the eye isn’t yours: give it up.

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness. …

verses.pali: yampidaṁ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tampi na tumhākaṁ.
verses.english: The pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on mind contact isn’t yours: give it up.

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissatī”ti.
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.”
